translation: In the dinghai year I returned to Suzhou to visit my parents, when I was fifty-two years old. Because my fingers were numb and my lips were drawn, my neck was stiff, my sinews had much scrofula, my shoulders and back had tinea, and my waist felt like worms crawling, although eating, drinking, and daily life were still as usual, only my virility was not strong. My parents ordered me to be examined by a famous physician, who said that qi and blood were both depleted, and it was hard to expect to escape the body; it was necessary to use aconite and cinnamon heavily to greatly supplement qi and blood. He set a formula and left. Because I had previously found that taking hot medicines always made my teeth bleed, I set it aside.
